recipe:
set -e
x=$(mktemp -d) && tar xzf results/baseline/data_vectors/xi_scan/xi_sweep_bundle.tar.gz -C $x
c=$(mktemp -d) && tar xzf results/baseline/covariances/cov_scan/cov_sweep_bundle.tar.gz -C $c
o=$(mktemp -d)
b="$(python src/workflow/scripts/decision_values.py fiducial_blind blind_a)"
versions=$(python src/papers/bmodes/scripts/catalog_versions.py size_cut applied --nonfiducial)
for ver in $versions; do
  cb=covariance_"$ver"_"$b"_integration
  bash src/papers/bmodes/scripts/run_pure_eb_covariance.sh \
    --version "$ver" --blind "$b" \
    --cat-config src/cosmo_val/cat_config.yaml \
    --xi-reporting "$x/$ver"_xi_minsep=1.0_maxsep=250.0_nbins=20_npatch=1.txt \
    --xi-integration "$x/$ver"_xi_minsep=0.5_maxsep=300.0_nbins=1000_npatch=1.txt \
    --cov-integration "$c/$cb/$cb"_processed.txt \
    --integration-method fixed_operator \
    --integration-limits fine_grid_extent \
    --rebinning-weights npairs \
    --covariance-method exact_linear \
    --out-file "$o/$ver"_"$b"_pure_eb_covariance.npz
done
tar czf results/baseline/covariances/pure_eb_covariance_sweep.tar.gz -C $o .
